title: Grateful Dead Live at Avalon Ballroom on 1966-05-19
source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat -> Sonic Solutions -> CD

ai_review.summary: Soundboard capture of the May 19 1966 Avalon benefit show delivers an early‑psychedelic set with standout Mindbender moments, though some listeners feel Jerry’s tone was still developing.
ai_review.review: The recording is a sound‑board source that most fans find solid and enjoyable, preserving the raw, psychedelic energy of the mid‑60s Dead. While many praise the vibrato‑laden Mindbender and the rare “Tastebud” (aka Come Back Baby) track, a few note that Garcia’s guitar tone had not yet fully blossomed, giving the show a mixed but overall positive feel.

ai_rating.rationale: Average star rating across eight reviews is ~4.1; most comments are favorable about performance and recording, with a minority expressing disappointment in tone, leading to a solid but not exceptional overall score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers did not comment on specific audio flaws or clarity issues, implying the soundboard capture is generally acceptable though no detailed evaluation was provided.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Early‑psychedelic set typical of ’66, highlighted by experimental guitar/voice vibrato; overall flow is appreciated despite some criticism of Garcia’s tone.

band_member_comments.Jerry: One reviewer finds his tone indifferent and not fully developed, while another defends it and notes impressive vibrato on Mindbender.
band_member_comments.Phil: Praised for using vocal/ guitar vibrato together on Mindbender; no negative comments.
band_member_comments.Bob: Criticized by a single reviewer for lacking tonal maturity; otherwise not mentioned.
